paragraphs: In the morning, patrol assigned districts and check license plates and parking-space markings. Around midday, photograph violations, gather evidence, print notices, and place them on vehicles. When vehicle owners argue, explain the relevant rules. In the afternoon, enter and archive records and flag recurring hotspots. Before leaving, hand over the shift and prepare the next day's priority routes.

In short: bring order to illegal parking. Tasks include street patrols, rule verification, evidence collection, issuing notices, dispute handling, and archiving. It requires both walking and talking on the front line of parking order.
